comments.text: From a painful chapter of Vietnam's history to one of its most beautiful island destinations, Phu Quoc has an incredible story to tell. 🇻🇳🌴 Thank you for joining us on this journey! ❤ If you visited Phu Quoc, would you rather explore its traditional fishing villages or experience its modern island paradise? Let us know in the comments, and don't forget to like and subscribe for more travel documentaries!
